weeks.title: Week 1: Core Concepts
weeks.html:
Background

Pinnacle Development Group operates through complex multi-entity structure accommodating investor requirements and project risks. As CFO, you must oversee complete consolidation including intercompany eliminations, partnership accounting, and non-controlling interests.

Corporate Structure

Pinnacle Holdings LLC (Parent)

├── Pinnacle Construction Services LLC (100%)

├── Pinnacle Management Company LLC (100%)

├── Sunset Ridge Apartments LP (80%, 20% institutional)

├── River Walk Townhomes LLC (60%, 40% individuals)

└── Oak Plaza Commercial JV (45%, 55% strategic partner)

Current Financial Position

Total Assets: $125M

Total Debt: $78M

Equity: $47M

Revenue: $95M

EBITDA: $18.5M

DSCR: 2.26x

Challenge Scenarios

Scenario 1: Complex Intercompany Structure Pinnacle Management charges fees to all projects, Construction provides services to projects, Holdings provides financing to subsidiaries.

Scenario 2: Partnership Allocations Sunset Ridge has preferred returns, River Walk has promote arrangements, Oak Plaza requires equity method treatment.

Scenario 3: Non-Controlling Interests Different ownership percentages and profit-sharing requiring precise calculations and proper presentation.

Required Deliverables

1. Consolidation Working Papers Prepare complete worksheets including:

Individual entity statements

All elimination entries with explanations

Non-controlling interest calculations

Consolidated balance sheet and income statement

2. Intercompany Analysis Document all intercompany relationships:

Management fee agreements and calculations

Construction service contracts and pricing

Loan agreements and interest rates

Cost sharing arrangements and allocations

3. Partnership Accounting For Sunset Ridge LP:

Capital account maintenance

Preferred return calculations

Distribution waterfall analysis

K-1 preparation requirements

4. VIE Assessment Analyze Oak Plaza JV for VIE status:

Equity sufficiency test

Decision-making rights analysis

Economic benefits and losses assessment

Primary beneficiary determination

5. Technology Integration Plan Design system requirements for:

Multi-entity chart of accounts

Automated intercompany matching

Real-time consolidation processing

Exception reporting and controls

Expected Outcomes

Accurate consolidated financial statements

Compliant intercompany documentation

Efficient consolidation process (5-day cycle)

Strong internal controls and audit trail

Scalable technology platform for growth
